intro: The shop grant caps transfers at {{fact:grant1-cap-xlm}} XLM per {{fact:grant1-period-ledgers}} ledgers; *t* is an illustrative ledger. At ledger *L* the window holds the charges made after *L* − 100 and through *L*.
outro: The charge of 6 made at *t* stops counting at *t* + 100, and the charge of 4 made at *t* + 1 stops counting at *t* + 101, when the window holds only the 5.
